title: Real-Time Short-Response Selection for Spoken Dialogue Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.09057v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To realize spoken dialogue systems that can interact naturally with users, it is important for the system to respond to user utterances at appropriate timings. To achieve such natural turn-taking, the system needs not only to predict appropriate response timings but also to mask delays caused by language generation and speech synthesis so that they are not perceived by the user. We propose a real-time short-response selection task that can be integrated with existing turn-taking models to mask generation delay. To address this task, the proposed model learns the mapping between dialogue context and short responses using contrastive learning. translated_title: 口语对话系统中的实时短回应选择
translated_abstract: 为了实现能够与用户自然交互的口语对话系统，系统在合适的时机对用户话语进行回应至关重要。为实现这种自然的对话轮替，系统不仅需要预测合适的回应时机，还需要掩盖语言生成和语音合成造成的延迟，使其不被用户察觉。我们提出了一个可与现有对话轮替模型集成的实时短回应选择任务，以掩盖生成延迟。为解决该任务，所提出的模型使用对比学习来学习对话语境与短回应之间的映射。当检测到对话轮替事件时，系统从一组预先生成的候选回应中选择一个回应，并在主回应生成期间播放所选的短回应。实验结果表明，所提出的方法能够学会基于对话语境选择短回应……
tldr: 提出了一种基于对比学习的实时短回应选择方法，在检测到对话轮替事件时从预生成候选中即时选择并播放短回应，从而有效掩盖口语对话系统中语言生成与语音合成的延迟。
en_tdlr: Proposes a contrastive-learning-based real-time short-response selection method that instantly selects and plays pre-generated short responses upon turn-taking events, effectively masking language generation and speech synthesis delays in spoken dialogue systems.
